newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Telecom leads New Zealand shares to weaker close.
newsitem.headline: Telecom leads New Zealand shares to weaker close.

text.p: * NZ shares ease in line with weak U.S., Australian markets
* Higher local interest rates weigh on market
* Shares close on lows, volume light
133 nil * NZSE-40 cap index -14.78 at 2,378.47 334 nil * NZSC cap index -7.81 at 5,123.02 282 -2 * NZSE-10 cap index -7.91 at 1,190.09
Telecom led New Zealand shares to a lower close on light volume on Tuesday, taking their cue from weakness on Wall Street and in Australia.
The NZSE-40 capital index shed 14.78 points to end at 2,378.47 on volume of just NZ$35 million, with Telecom 12 cents weaker at $7.35.
"Weakness in the U.S. and Australia, and slightly higher interest rates here, have all taken their toll today," said Tim Koller, broker at Merrill Lynch.
Brewer Lion Nathan showed resilience, gaining five cents to $3.68, while among the other leaders Brierley Investments and Carter Holt Harvey were unchanged.
A stand in the market by Australia's Just Jeans Holdings for clothing retailer Underground Fashions was making good initial progress.
Just Jeans, which has agreed to buy the 71.4 percent holding of the Rissetto family and is seeking the balance of 7.4 million shares, had snapped up 1,075,000 at the bid price of 33.5 cents.
Brokers said the fact the market closed on its lows was a negative sign, and the trend for Wednesday was likely to be set by Wall Street. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
